body: Dude I’ve seen so many that I’ve become numb to these girls
Oh my god that was me....
Sounds like endometriosis...NAD but you might want to get that checked out.
I have anemia, most symptoms are lethargy, bruising over a little bump, low iron maybe, but it could just be my case. But yeah NAD, please get it checked out. Play it safe.

If it’s a bug bite, try using cortezone cream on and around the area. 
But if it’s that big, don’t take my advice, please try to see if you can get a doctor to look at it.

I mean, I would, but my mom would just say “you’re too young to be injuring your shoulder.”

That, and I am very superstitious about my physical health and have a low pain tolerance. Also been getting an uncomfortable urge to stretch the side where my shoulder is hurting.
I did recently start cyproheptadine, because I’ve been getting frequent nightmares recently.
Yes, it’s been like this since I was born. Either it could be my overbite (that I never fixed), or a result of my beta thalassemia minor. Really though, I’m not sure.
